sketches.mechanism: A let binding creates a temporal dead zone: the name is in scope before initialization, but any access to it throws a ReferenceError.
sketches.resonance: The future is already named, yet touching it before its time breaks the world.

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: \+ Goal succeeds when Goal cannot be proven from the current knowledge base.
sketches.resonance: Absence is not discovered as a fact, but produced by the failure to find presence.

sketches.mechanism: The operand of sizeof is unevaluated, so an expression can be measured without being executed.
sketches.resonance: A danger can be given its exact size without ever being allowed to happen.
